summary.text: Seth Manley is a Republican candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Chittenden-22 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Manley ran for the Chittenden-22 seat in 2022 as a Republican and lost the general election to incumbents Lori Houghton and Karen Dolan, receiving 1,271 votes, or 18.5 percent.
He advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
